info.name: RideLink - End-to-end workflows
info.description:
IT3130 RideLink. Runs every required workflow across the four services in order: accounts and roles, driver preparation, fare estimation, ride request and assignment, ride lifecycle, completion and payment, and negative scenarios. Every request asserts its status code; ids and tokens are passed between requests as collection variables, and a fresh run id keeps emails and plates unique.

Before running: start all four services with the dev profile, import RideLink-Local environment and set internalApiKey and adminPassword to your local values. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner.
